additional_notes: Note: I have not considered the possibility of 'bolasing' monsters, chariots or the like. Aside from complication when it comes to the effect on crews and such, it seems unlikely a vast monster or construction would be all that inconvenienced.

special_army_rule.name: Cold-Eyed
special_army_rule.description: Cold-eyed is a new special rule that applies to all Lizardmen and Efts; cold-blooded creatures not easily stirred by adversity. This is costed as 1pt per model. When taking any test against Command the unit ignores the usual -1 penalty applied for one pin. So, 1 pin would impose no penalty, 2 pins a penalty of -1, 3 pins -2 and so on. When making an Order test, a test is still required if the unit has a single pin, even though the usual -1 penalty is ignored and the test made against the full Command value.

special_rules.Choking: No armour bonus or cover bonus allowed.
special_rules.Command: Friendly units within 10" can use the model's Co stat to take Command based tests.
special_rules.Cold-Eyed: When taking any test against Command the unit ignores the usual -1 penalty applied for one pin.
special_rules.Disciplined: Loses all pins when it passes a Rally test.
special_rules.Divine Intervention: Can steal an order dice from an enemy unit within 20" with successful Command test. If fail take 1 pin instead. Maximum of one attempt in any turn.
special_rules.Dread: -1 to hit shooting/close combat. -1 to break test if defeated by dreaded enemy.
special_rules.Hero: Friendly units within 10" can use the model's Initiative stat to take Reaction tests.
special_rules.Fast: Move at the basic rate indicated.
special_rules.Flies: Moves over any terrain/obstacles without test or penalties.
special_rules.Follow: Friendly un-pinned units within 5" can follow the unit's order immediately.
special_rules.Irresistible Charge: D3 SV (Strike Value) bonus when charging.
special_rules.Large: +1 to hit shooting. Can draw LOS to body. Can draw LOS over non-large models.
special_rules.Rapid Sprint: Sprint at 4x Move rate (4M) rather than 3M.
special_rules.Spirit: Can be sacrificed for a re-roll. Destroyed if wizard is slain.
special_rules.Stampede: Stampede on failed Order test of 10. D10" +2M in direction shown by dice. Each unit in path is attacked as if charged.
special_rules.Surly: Cannot benefit from Command, Hero or Follow rule.
special_rules.Terror: Units within 15" remove no pins when taking an order test. Units failing a break test within 5" are automatically destroyed.
special_rules.Tough: Re-roll a failed Res test (Tough 2 re-roll 2 separate fails, and so on).
special_rules.Venomous: Add +1 hit from unit if any venomous hits are scored.
special_rules.Wound: Can lose the 'wounds value' of lives before a further Res fail slays.
